Block number recorded to derive the random starting index; set in mint/emergencySetStartingIndexBlock.
Randomized starting index for token reveal, derived from blockhash modulo MAX_OCTO.
Constant mint price of 0.08 ETH per token.
Constant maximum number of tokens mintable in a single transaction (20).
Maximum total NFT supply, set in the constructor.
Boolean flag controlling whether public minting is enabled.
Timestamp after which the starting index block may be recorded.
Sets MAX_OCTO and REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from constructor arguments.
Owner-only function transferring the full contract balance to msg.sender.
Owner-only function minting 30 reserved tokens to msg.sender.
Owner-only setter for REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Owner-only setter for OCS_PROVENANCE.
Owner-only setter forwarding to ERC721 _setBaseURI.
Owner-only function toggling saleIsActive.
Payable public mint function validating sale state, per-tx limit, supply cap and payment, then safe-minting tokens.
Public function computing startingIndex from blockhash; relies on weak randomness.
Owner-only fallback to set startingIndexBlock if it was never recorded.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, minting recipient and fund transfer.
Miner-influenceable timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mint.
External value transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender in withdraw.
_safeMint triggering the onERC721Received callback on the recipient contract.
blockhash-derived randomness used to compute startingIndex.
Number of tokens requested in mint.
New reveal timestamp passed to setRevealTimestamp.
New provenance hash passed to setProvenanceHash.
New base URI passed to setBaseURI.
Local copy of address(this).balance in withdraw.
Local totalSupply snapshot in reserveOctos.

edges.reason: numberOfTokens controls the mint loop iteration count and payment check.
revealTimeStamp is assigned to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
provenanceHash is assigned to OCS_PROVENANCE.
baseURI is forwarded to ERC721 _setBaseURI.
msg.sender receives the whole contract balance in withdraw.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external balance transfer, an external call point.
Local balance is the amount sent by the low-level transfer.
supply snapshot is used to compute reserved token ids.
loop counter i drives the reserved mint loop.
mintIndex derived from totalSupply is the id used in _safeMint.
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide startingIndexBlock recording (timestamp dependency).
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP gates when startingIndexBlock is set.
saleIsActive must be true for mint to proceed.
MAX_OCTO caps the total supply during mint.
octoPrice is multiplied by token count for the payment requirement.
maxOctoPurchase bounds numberOfTokens per transaction.
MAX_OCTO is the modulus applied to the blockhash to derive startingIndex.
startingIndex is zero-checked and written in setStartingIndex.
startingIndexBlock is read to obtain the past blockhash.
blockhash-derived value is assigned to startingIndex (weak randomness).
msg.sender is the recipient of the minted tokens in mint.
msg.sender receives the reserved tokens in reserveOctos.
msg.sender-supplied recipient address is passed into _safeMint.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, allowing reentrant control flow.
Deployer/owner context is derived through _msgSender in the constructor chain.
onlyOwner modifier restricts withdraw execution to the owner, checked against msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates reserveOctos on msg.sender being the owner.
onlyOwner gates setRevealTimestamp.
onlyOwner gates setProvenanceHash.
onlyOwner gates setBaseURI.
onlyOwner gates flipSaleState.
onlyOwner gates emergencySetStartingIndexBlock.
setStartingIndex is publicly callable; anyone can finalize the index-based reveal.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens only exists to parameterize the mint function's validation and loop.
revealTimeStamp is a pure input argument written to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
provenanceHash is a pure input argument written to OCS_PROVENANCE.
baseURI is a pure input argument forwarded to _setBaseURI.
balance is a transient local used solely as the value of the external transfer.
supply is a transient snapshot used only within reserveOctos.
i is a transient loop counter local to reserveOctos.
mintIndex is a transient local token id used only inside mint's loop.
